sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日商业与政策通讯《DealBook》的报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，与商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖进行现场对话，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行免费直播，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: At the heart of the impeachment is a request made by President Trump.
sentences.zh: 弹劾案的核心是特朗普总统提出的一项请求。

sentences.en: That Ukraine investigate ties between the Bidens and an energy company called Burisma.
sentences.zh: 要求乌克兰调查拜登父子与一家名为布里斯马的能源公司之间的联系。

sentences.en: Now, new reporting from the Times suggests that Russian hackers may be trying to fulfill that requeSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，《纽约时报》的最新报道表明，俄罗斯黑客可能正在试图满足这一请求。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月15日，星期三。

sentences.en: Nicole Porroth, tell me what happened the other day.
sentences.zh: 妮可·珀罗斯，告诉我前几天发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, I've been covering cybersecurity at the Times for about eight years, and I'd been working on a story for a couple months about threats to the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》报道网络安全大约八年了，几个月来我一直在做一个关于2020年大选威胁的故事。

sentences.en: And as part of that story, I'd been speaking to a source of mine.
sentences.zh: 作为该报道的一部分，我一直在与我的一个消息源交谈。

sentences.en: His name's Oren Falkowitz.
sentences.zh: 他叫奥伦·法科维茨。

sentences.en: He was a former analyst at the National Security Agency, and now he runs a Silicon Valley company that blocks phishing attacks.
sentences.zh: 他是国家安全局的前分析师，现在经营着一家位于硅谷的公司，专门拦截钓鱼攻击。

sentences.en: And he's been working with a lot of the Democratic candidates for 2020, and he'd given me an interesting number in the course of that reporting,
sentences.zh: 他一直在与许多2020年民主党候选人合作，在采访过程中，他给我提供了一个有趣的数据，

sentences.en: which was that already the Democratic frontrunners for 2020 have been getting an average of something like a thousand phishing attempts in the last couple months.
sentences.zh: 那就是在过去几个月里，2020年民主党领跑者平均已经遭遇了大约上千次网络钓鱼攻击。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's a huge number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: And so, I gave him a call to just do some basic fact-checking as we were going to print, and I happened to catch him at an interesting time.
sentences.zh: 因此，正当我们准备付梓时，我打电话给他进行一些基本的事实核查，碰巧在一个有趣的时刻联系到了他。

sentences.en: And he said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I actually think I might have something bigger for you.
sentences.zh: 我实际上觉得我可能有什么更重大的消息要告诉你。

sentences.en: Can I call you back later?
sentences.zh: 我稍后能给你回电话吗？

sentences.en: That's a very juicy little tease for a source to give a reporter.
sentences.zh: 这对记者来说是一个非常吸引人的小悬念。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 所以，你怎么办？

sentences.en: Hey, Oren.
sentences.zh: 嘿，奥伦。

sentences.en: Hey, Nicole.
sentences.zh: 嘿，妮可。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: It's good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm great.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I call him back.
sentences.zh: 我给他回了电话。

sentences.en: So, let's start from the top.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们从头说起。

sentences.en: And he starts to tell me the full story.
sentences.zh: 他开始把整个故事告诉我。

sentences.en: So, starting about New Year's Eve, he was actually at Disney World with his kids, and he was in line for the teacups ride, as he tells it.
sentences.zh: 从跨年夜开始，他其实正带着孩子在迪士尼世界，据他所说，当时他正在排队坐旋转茶杯。

sentences.en: Naturally.
sentences.zh: 理所当然。

sentences.en: And someone on his team sends him a Slack message.
sentences.zh: 然后他团队里的某个人给他发了一条 Slack 消息。

sentences.en: And it said, found a bunch of Russian phishing attacks going after Ukrainians, targeting natural gas.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，发现了一堆针对乌克兰人的俄罗斯钓鱼攻击，目标是天然气。

sentences.en: There is an active Russian phishing campaign against some companies in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 有一场针对乌克兰某些公司的活跃的俄罗斯钓鱼活动。

sentences.en: You know, it's a pretty boring run-of-the-mill, but I'm going to keep tabs on it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这挺无聊也很常规的，但我会关注它。

sentences.en: And if they swing more towards U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果他们更多地转向美国

sentences.en: targets, you know, we can spend some extra time looking at it.
sentences.zh: 目标，你知道的，我们可以花点额外时间来看看。

sentences.en: A couple days later,
sentences.zh: 几天后，

sentences.en: a different person on their team was giving a presentation about threats to the oil and gas industry and took a little bit of a closer look at what these attacks against Ukraine were all about.
sentences.zh: 他们团队的另一个人正在做一个关于石油和天然气行业威胁的演讲，并对这些针对乌克兰的攻击究竟是怎么回事进行了更仔细的观察。

sentences.en: And she started to notice, after a little digging, that all three gas companies that had been found were related to this company, Burisma.
sentences.zh: 在稍微挖掘之后，她开始注意到，被发现的三家天然气公司都与这家名为布里斯马的公司有关。

sentences.en: They were all subsidiaries of Burisma.
sentences.zh: 它们全都是布里斯马的子公司。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The company at the center of the Trump impeachment inquiry and the company on which Hunter Biden sat on the board.
sentences.zh: 这家公司正是特朗普弹劾调查的核心，也是亨特·拜登曾担任董事的公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Oren's team takes a close look at these attacks, and they find out that these are pretty sophisticated phishing attacks, for one.
sentences.zh: 所以奥伦的团队仔细研究了这些攻击，他们发现首先这些是相当复杂的钓鱼攻击。

sentences.en: In this case, fake websites to look exactly like Burisma Holding Company's websites, so that when a user visited them, they wouldn't really know the difference.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，假冒网站看起来与布里斯马控股公司的网站一模一样，因此当用户访问时，他们真的分不清区别。

sentences.en: They've taken something like KUBgas.com.ua and just disposed of the .ua.
sentences.zh: 他们拿走了诸如 KUBgas.com.ua 之类的网址，直接去掉了 .ua。

sentences.en: So these employees are looking at the website address, and why should they even assume that their company doesn't own the .com domain?
sentences.zh: 所以这些员工看着网址，为什么他们会觉得自己的公司不拥有 .com 域名呢？

sentences.en: That would allow them, you know, in some of these websites to ask for usernames and passwords.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这会允许他们在其中一些网站上索取用户名和密码。

sentences.en: And once those are given away, they can go and do other things like access their emails, start sending emails on their behalf, and going further into their network,
sentences.zh: 一旦泄露出去，他们就可以做其他事情，比如访问他们的电子邮件、开始以他们的名义发送邮件、并进一步渗透到他们的网络中，

sentences.en: probably to achieve some goal that we don't understand yet.
sentences.zh: 很可能是为了达到某种我们目前还不理解的目的。

sentences.en: So what they saw was that people were indeed accessing these fake login pages.
sentences.zh: 所以他们看到的是，人们确实在访问这些虚假的登录页面。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And do we know how successful these attacks have been?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这些攻击有多成功吗？

sentences.en: The attacks have been successful.
sentences.zh: 这些攻击已经成功了。

sentences.en: And giving away their usernames and passwords.
sentences.zh: 并泄露了他们的用户名和密码。

sentences.en: What they've accomplished is yet to be determined.
sentences.zh: 他们究竟完成了什么还有待确定。

sentences.en: We don't know what happens after that.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这之后会发生什么。

sentences.en: Orin's team can't say whether they got any emails at all, whether they got any material that would be embarrassing to Joe Biden or his son.
sentences.zh: 奥伦的团队无法确定他们是否获取了任何电子邮件，是否获取了任何会让乔·拜登或他儿子难堪的材料。

sentences.en: But what's clear is they successfully got in.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，他们成功潜入了。

sentences.en: So on its base, this would not actually be that weird.
sentences.zh: 所以从根本上说，这其实并没有那么奇怪。

sentences.en: Ukraine is known as sort of Russia's test kitchen for hacking and cyber attacks.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰被称为俄罗斯黑客攻击和网络袭击的“试验田”。

sentences.en: It's basically been under constant attack since before 2014.
sentences.zh: 基本上自2014年之前开始，它就一直在遭受持续不断的攻击。

sentences.en: But when they started unwinding some of these campaigns back, there were two things that stood out.
sentences.zh: 但当他们开始回溯并逐步摸清其中一些行动时，有两点非常引人注目。

sentences.en: One, this isn't some random Russian cybercriminal group.
sentences.zh: 第一，这不是什么随意的俄罗斯网络犯罪团伙。

sentences.en: This is Fancy Bear, the name of the group that private security researchers give to the GRU, Russia's main intelligence directorate.
sentences.zh: 这是“花熊”（Fancy Bear），这是私营安全研究人员给GRU起的名字，也就是俄罗斯的主要情报总局。

sentences.en: The same group that hit John Podesta, Hillary Clinton's campaign chairman, back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 就是2016年攻击希拉里·克林顿竞选团队主席约翰·波德斯塔的同一个团伙。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the same group is doing the attack on Verispa.
sentences.zh: 所以是同一个团伙在对维里帕发动攻击。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The other thing that was interesting was the timing.
sentences.zh: 另一件有趣的事是时间点。

sentences.en: When Orin's team went back and looked at the timestamps, this was early November.
sentences.zh: 当奥林的团队回过头去查看时间戳时，发现那是11月初。

sentences.en: And you have to remember where we were in early November.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住我们在11月初处于什么状况。

sentences.en: The private testimony of the impeachment witnesses before the House Intelligence Committee had just wrapped up and we were about to start the public hearings.
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会弹劾案证人的闭门证词刚刚结束，我们正准备开始公开听证会。

sentences.en: So this division of the GRU is targeting Burisma at the very same moment when Burisma is suddenly at the center of the national conversation in the impeachment process.
sentences.zh: 所以，GRU的这个部门将乌克兰天然气公司作为目标，而此时恰好乌克兰天然气公司突然成为了弹劾程序中全国讨论的焦点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Here we are again.
sentences.zh: 我们又回到原点L了。

sentences.en: Given that we're so close to the first votes being cast in the elections.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们距离选举中投下第一张选票已经这么近了。

sentences.en: With an election year coming up.
sentences.zh: 随着选举年的到来。

sentences.en: This is starting to look more like the pattern that we have seen in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这开始变得越来越像我们在2016年见过的模式。

sentences.en: With a Russian hack of a sensitive Democratic target.
sentences.zh: 伴随着俄罗斯对民主党敏感目标的黑客攻击。

sentences.en: So Nicole, as he is telling you this, what are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 妮可，当他向你讲述这些时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I'm thinking this is 2016 all over again.
sentences.zh: 我在想，这简直就是2016年的重演。

sentences.en: So I had been told that we were going to see a lot of foreign interference in this election.
sentences.zh: 所以我之前被告知，我们将在这次选举中看到大量的外部干预。

sentences.en: Not just from Russia, but because Russia had offered a playbook for interference for every other country that had any other incentive to influence the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 不仅来自俄罗斯，而且因为俄罗斯为所有其他有意愿影响2020年大选的国家提供了一套干预的行动指南。

sentences.en: We were told we were going to be getting hit from all sides.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知我们将遭到来自四面八方的打击。

sentences.en: But I had fully expected that perhaps because Russian tactics and techniques had been spilled over the Mueller report and in private security intelligence assessments that we would see something more sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 但我原本完全预期，或许由于俄罗斯的战术和技术已经在穆勒报告中以及私人安全情报评估中被曝光，我们会看到更sophisticated的东西。

sentences.en: But when Oren was describing this, it was a cookie cutter repeat of what happened to John Podesta back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 但当奥伦描述这一切时，这简直是2016年发生在约翰·波德斯塔身上事件的复制粘贴。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Who would use the exact same technique twice?
sentences.zh: 谁会用完全相同的技术用两次？

sentences.en: Apparently the GRU does.
sentences.zh: 显然GRU会。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，甚至不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载纽约时报应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Nicole, you said you were talking to Oren as part of your reporting on what to expect from Russia in 2020.
sentences.zh: 妮可，你说你是在报道2020年对俄罗斯的预期时与奥伦交谈的。

sentences.en: But as you've observed, this story that he told you, it sounds like they're up to the exact same thing as they were in 2016.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所观察到的，他告诉你的这个故事听起来他们正在做和2016年完全一样的事情。

sentences.en: Why would that be, given that they were caught in the sense that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们已经被抓了个正着，也就是美国

sentences.en: understands what they did in 2016?
sentences.zh: 了解他们在2016年所做的事情，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why would they just use the same tactics in 2020?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们在2020年还要使用相同的战术？

sentences.en: Because it still works.
sentences.zh: 因为这依然管用。

sentences.en: People will still click on these links.
sentences.zh: 人们依然会点击这些链接。

sentences.en: People will still turn over their passwords.
sentences.zh: 人们依然会交出他们的密码。

sentences.en: We know people won't turn on this thing called two-factor authentication to make sure people can't just hack into their computers from a strange location.
sentences.zh: 我们知道人们不会开启双重身份验证这个功能，来确保别人无法从陌生地点直接黑进他们的电脑。

sentences.en: And we also know that the outcome can be the same.
sentences.zh: 而且我们也知道结果可能是一样的。

sentences.en: We know that in 2016...
sentences.zh: 我们知道在2016年……

sentences.en: Breaking tonight less than two weeks until Election Day and hacked emails from the account of Hillary Clinton's campaign chairman, John Podesta,
sentences.zh: 今晚突发新闻，距离选举日不到两周，希拉里·克林顿竞选团队主席约翰·波德斯塔账户的被黑邮件，

sentences.en: are raising new questions about Mrs. Clinton and her candidacy.
sentences.zh: 引发了对克林顿夫人及其竞选资格的新质疑。

sentences.en: When Russian hackers and trolls dumped John Podesta's emails and emails at the DNC, people devoured them.
sentences.zh: 当俄罗斯黑客和水军倾倒约翰·波德斯塔的邮件以及民主党全国委员会的邮件时，人们如饥似渴地阅读着。

sentences.en: After thousands of leaked emails showed Democratic Party officials possibly plotting against Bernie Sanders in his race against Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 在数千封泄露的邮件显示民主党官员可能在伯尼·桑德斯与希拉里·克林顿的竞选中密谋反对他之后。

sentences.en: People wanted to believe that the race was fixed for Hillary Clinton from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 人们愿意相信这场竞选从一开始就是为希拉里·克林顿内定的。

sentences.en: They planned this, they set it up, they didn't give us a chance.
sentences.zh: 他们策划了这一切，他们布好了局，他们根本没给我们机会。

sentences.en: They came together pretty much to shut Bernie out.
sentences.zh: 他们齐心协力几乎把伯尼排挤在外。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty obvious.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太明显了。

sentences.en: And what they did was they looked in those emails for any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 而他们所做的就是在那些邮件中寻找这方面的任何证据。

sentences.en: And we got to a place where the Russians successfully sowed American discord.
sentences.zh: 我们走到了这样一个地步：俄罗斯人成功地播下了美国的不和。

sentences.en: And we have got to elect Hillary Clinton and Tim Kaine.
sentences.zh: 我们必须选出希拉里·克林顿和蒂姆·凯恩。

sentences.en: They basically poured fuel on the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在火上浇油。

sentences.en: And when you think about where we are in 2020, there's no evidence to suggest that the outcome wouldn't be the exact same.
sentences.zh: 当你想到我们现在身处2020年时，没有任何证据表明结果不会完全一样。

sentences.en: When you think about what President Trump was saying last summer and into the fall...
sentences.zh: 当你回想特朗普总统去年夏天和秋天一直在说的话……

sentences.en: They should investigate the Bidens, because that is a company that's newly formed...
sentences.zh: 他们应该调查拜登父子，因为那是一家新成立的公司……

sentences.en: That Burisma was corrupt.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰天然气公司是腐败的。

sentences.en: That was a crooked deal, 100%.
sentences.zh: 那是百分之百的肮脏交易。

sentences.en: That there was widespread corruption in Ukraine that he wanted investigated.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰存在他希望进行调查的广泛腐败现象。

sentences.en: Ukraine is known as a very, very corrupt place.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰被称为一个非常、非常腐败的地方。

sentences.en: And they know that.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这一点。

sentences.en: And you think about what Russian hackers could potentially get from getting inside Burisma's systeMs.
sentences.zh: 当你想到俄罗斯黑客通过侵入乌克兰天然气公司的系统可能会得到什么时。

sentences.en: They might not necessarily find anything that is an exhibit A of corruption.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不一定能找到任何作为腐败铁证的东西。

sentences.en: But if you selectively leaked emails out of context,
sentences.zh: 但如果你把邮件断章取义地选择性泄露出去，

sentences.en: it'd be very easy in the current media climate and the current partisan climate for people to once again devour those emails and find whatever it is they want to find.
sentences.zh: 在当前的媒体气候和党派气候下，人们会非常容易地再次如饥似渴地阅读这些邮件，并找到他们想找到的任何东西。

sentences.en: There doesn't have to be all that much there there for it to effectively sow discord.
sentences.zh: 并不需要有那么多的实质内容，它就能有效地挑拨离间。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nicole, does the fact that the Russians are doing this in pretty much the exact same way as they did in 2016 suggest something about how the United States responded last time?
sentences.zh: 妮可，俄罗斯这次的做法几乎和2016年如出一辙，这是否暗示了美国上次的应对方式有问题？

sentences.en: If Russia feels empowered to pretty much do the same thing again?
sentences.zh: 如果俄罗斯觉得他们完全可以再次故技重施？

sentences.en: Well, I think it tells us that they didn't feel much pain from the Mueller report and sanctions and from the indictments against Russian hackers and trolls.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这说明他们觉得穆勒报告、制裁以及对俄罗斯黑客和水军的起诉并没有让他们感到多大痛楚。

sentences.en: I mean, you have to remember that even after the American intelligence community concluded that Russian hackers and trolls had interfered in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你必须记住，甚至在美国情报界得出俄罗斯黑客和水军干预了2016年大选的结论之后。

sentences.en: I don't think anybody knows it was Russia that broke into the DNC.
sentences.zh: 我不认为任何人知道是俄罗斯入侵了民主党全国委员会。

sentences.en: She's saying Russia, Russia, Russia.
sentences.zh: 她一直在说俄罗斯、俄罗斯、俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But I don't maybe it was.
sentences.zh: 但我不确定也许真是他们。

sentences.en: I mean, it could be Russia, but it could also be China.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可能是俄罗斯，但也可能是中国。

sentences.en: Could also be lots of other people.
sentences.zh: 也可能是其他许多人。

sentences.en: It also could be somebody sitting on their bed that weighs 400 pounds.
sentences.zh: 也可能是一个体重400磅、坐在自己床上的人。

sentences.en: OK, the president was still blaming a 400 pound guy sitting on his bed.
sentences.zh: 好的，总统仍然在归咎于一个坐在床上的400磅胖子。

sentences.en: You don't know who broke in to DNC.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道是谁入侵了民主党全国委员会。

sentences.en: In Helsinki, the president said.
sentences.zh: 在赫尔辛基，总统说过。

sentences.en: People came to me.
sentences.zh: 有人来找过我。

sentences.en: Dan Coats came to me and some others.
sentences.zh: 丹·科茨和其他一些人来找过我。

sentences.en: They said they think it's Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们认为是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: I have President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我有普京总统的话。

sentences.en: He just said it's not Russia.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚说过这不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: I will say this.
sentences.zh: 我要这么说。

sentences.en: I don't see any reason why it would be.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么理由会是他们。

sentences.en: I don't know why it would have been Russia.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么会是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And more recently.
sentences.zh: 而就在最近。

sentences.en: Today was their first time meeting face to face since the release of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 今天是自穆勒报告发布以来他们首次面对面会晤。

sentences.en: When a reporter asked Trump at a press conference.
sentences.zh: 当记者在记者会上问特朗普时。

sentences.en: Will you tell Vladimir Putin not to interfere in 2020?
sentences.zh: 你会告诉弗拉基米尔·普京不要干预2020年大选吗？

sentences.en: And you can even see it right there.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以直接看到那一幕。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump wagging his finger at Putin, all with a smile.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生向普京摇着手指，脸上带着微笑。

sentences.en: Trump wagged his finger jovially and said don't interfere in 2020.
sentences.zh: 特朗普开玩笑地摇着手指，说不要干预2020年。

sentences.en: There has been no repercussions for Russian interference in 2016.
sentences.zh: 对于2016年俄罗斯的干预行为，没有任何后果。

sentences.en: At least not enough to keep them from doing the same thing all over again in 2020.
sentences.zh: 至少不足以阻止他们在2020年重蹈覆辙。

sentences.en: And of course, the president is now also advancing the theory that it was Ukraine and not Russia that interfered in 2016.
sentences.zh: 当然，总统现在还提出了另一种说法，即干预2016年大选的是乌克兰，而不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Which further absolves Russia from its interference in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这进一步为俄罗斯2016年的干预行为开脱。

sentences.en: And is at the heart of the conspiracy theory that's gotten Trump impeached in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这也是导致特朗普遭到弹劾的阴谋论的核心所在。

sentences.en: So that's the bad news.
sentences.zh: 所以这是坏消息。

sentences.en: But it actually gets worse.
sentences.zh: 但实际上情况更糟。

sentences.en: If you remember back in 2016, the DNC was actually hacked by two groups of Russian hackers.
sentences.zh: 如果你回想2016年，民主党全国委员会实际上是被两批俄罗斯黑客入侵的。

sentences.en: The first was Fancy Bear, which we've now talked about.
sentences.zh: 第一批是“百熊”，我们刚才已经讨论过了。

sentences.en: The other was another Russian intelligence group called Cozy Bear.
sentences.zh: 另一批是另一个名为“舒适熊”的俄罗斯情报集团。

sentences.en: And what we now know from our reporting over the last six months is that, well, Fancy Bear's
sentences.zh: 而我们根据过去六个月的报道现在所了解到的是，尽管“百熊”

sentences.en: continued on with these very obvious phishing campaigns and is really up to its old tricks.
sentences.zh: 仍在继续进行这些非常明显的网络钓鱼活动，并且确实在重操旧业。

sentences.en: Cozy Bear, the other group that hacked the DNC back in 2016, has actually dropped off the radar.
sentences.zh: 另一支在2016年入侵民主党全国委员会的黑客团伙“舒适熊”实际上已经销声匿迹了。

sentences.en: So about six months ago, researchers I talked to had been following them.
sentences.zh: 所以在大约六个月前，我交谈过 研究人员一直在追踪他们。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, they sort of up and abandoned their hacking infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 而突然之间，他们差不多直接放弃了他们的黑客基础设施。

sentences.en: They switched out email accounts that were being monitored by the private sector and intelligence officials.
sentences.zh: 他们更换了正受到私营部门和情报官员监控的电子邮件账户。

sentences.en: They're now using things like secure anonymous email accounts that make it much harder for intelligence agencies and private researchers to track their communications.
sentences.zh: 他们现在开始使用安全匿名电子邮件账户之类的东西，这使得情报机构和私营研究人员更难追踪他们的通信。

sentences.en: So they've kind of gone dark.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有点进入黑暗中了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it gets a little scarier.
sentences.zh: 而且情况变得有点吓人了。

sentences.en: Cyber criminals are holding entire American cities, towns and counties hostage, and they're doing it with computer viruses called ransomware.
sentences.zh: 网络罪犯正在劫持整个美国的城市、城镇和县，他们使用的电脑病毒被称为勒索软件。

sentences.en: So one of the things that's just been happening separately from any of these Russian campaigns
sentences.zh: 因此，与过去一年中任何这些俄罗斯行动

sentences.en: over the last year is that American cities and towns have been getting hit with a record number of ransomware attacks.
sentences.zh: 独立发生的事情之一是，美国城市和城镇一直遭受着创纪录数量的勒索软件攻击。

sentences.en: So these are attacks when cyber criminals, usually looking for a profit, infect their computer systems, hold their data hostage until they pay a ransom.
sentences.zh: 所以这些攻击是网络罪犯（通常是为了牟利）感染他们的计算机系统，将其数据劫持直到他们支付赎金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: This happened in Baltimore, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，这发生在巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: The assault causing police emails to go down, as did the Board of Elections.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击导致警察局电子邮件瘫痪，选举委员会也是如此。

sentences.en: Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大。

sentences.en: The FBI is investigating a cyber attack on the city of Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局正在调查针对亚特兰大市的网络攻击。

sentences.en: The so-called ransomware attack on the city's computer network triggered outages across several departments.
sentences.zh: 针对该市计算机网络的所谓勒索软件攻击导致多个部门服务中断。

sentences.en: New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 新奥尔良。

sentences.en: The city of New Orleans crippled after a cyber attack.
sentences.zh: 新奥尔良市在遭受网络攻击后陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: Websites down.
sentences.zh: 网站瘫痪。

sentences.en: Phones unanswered.
sentences.zh: 电话无人接听。

sentences.en: The mayor declaring a state of emergency as local and federal officials work to figure out who's behind the hack and how much damage has been done.
sentences.zh: 市长宣布进入紧急状态，当地和联邦官员正在努力查明黑客幕后黑手以及造成的损失程度。

sentences.en: And what I learned in the course of my reporting over the last couple of months is that there
sentences.zh: 我在过去几个月的报道过程中了解到的是

sentences.en: is a question at the Homeland Security Department and among the intelligence community about whether
sentences.zh: 国土安全部和情报界存在一个疑问，即

sentences.en: these were just run-of-the-mill ransomware attacks or whether there was a GRU component.
sentences.zh: 这些仅仅是普通的勒索软件攻击，还是其中有格鲁乌（俄罗斯军情总局）的参与。

sentences.en: And the fear is that the attacks might actually just be decoys for some more nefarious sleuthing of these local election systeMs.
sentences.zh: 人们担心的是，这些攻击实际上可能只是对这些地方选举系统进行更邪恶侦察的诱饵。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, they have not concluded that this is the case, but this is something that the Department of Homeland Security is investigating.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们还没有得出这就是事实的结论，但这是国土安全部正在调查的事情。

sentences.en: And I think whether or not they conclude that there was some GRU component here, what those
sentences.zh: 我认为无论他们是否得出这里面有格鲁乌参与的结论，那些

sentences.en: ransomware attacks showed us is that American towns and cities are still so vulnerable to the type of attack that could really influence the vote on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 勒索软件攻击向我们表明，美国的城镇和城市仍然如此脆弱，极易受到那种真正可能影响选举日投票结果的攻击。

sentences.en: Can you help us understand what that might look like?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我们理解那会是什么样子吗？

sentences.en: So, one scenario is they change the votes.
sentences.zh: 所以，一种情况是他们更改了选票。

sentences.en: They hack into the actual ballot machines themselves and change people's votes without anyone's knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他们黑入实际的投票机本身，在无人知晓的情况下篡改人们的选票。

sentences.en: The other thing is that they could actually keep people from voting.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是他们实际上可以阻止人们投票。

sentences.en: They could hack into the software companies that make the software that's used to check people in at the polls.
sentences.zh: 他们可以黑进制作软件的公司，这些软件用于在投票站核对人们的身份。

sentences.en: Someone shows up on Election Day and they're told, you're not registered to vote, or it looks like you've already voted.
sentences.zh: 有人在选举日现身，却被告知你没有登记投票，或者看起来你已经投过票了。

sentences.en: That would essentially be something like digital disenfranchisement.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就像是数字剥夺公民权。

sentences.en: And here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Back in 2016, Russia actually hacked into a software company that provided the poll check-in systeMs.
sentences.zh: 早在2016年，俄罗斯确实黑入了一家提供投票登记核对系统的软件公司。

sentences.en: When people showed up in Durham, North Carolina on Election Day, which is a reliably blue county
sentences.zh: 当人们在选举日出现在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市投票时，这是一个在一个倾向摇摆州的县里

sentences.en: in an otherwise swing state to vote, there were a lot of people who were kept from voting that day.
sentences.zh: 铁杆民主党支持的县，那天有很多人被阻止投票。

sentences.en: And they were told, it looks like you're not registered to vote, even though they were standing there with their registration cards.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知，看起来你没有登记投票，尽管他们手里正拿着登记卡站在那里。

sentences.en: They were told they had to go to a different location.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知必须去另一个地点。

sentences.en: Some were told that they'd already voted.
sentences.zh: 有些人被告知他们已经投过票了。

sentences.en: And the county actually had to go to print paper.
sentences.zh: 该县实际上不得不改用纸质打印投票。

sentences.en: And it cast a lot of doubt that perhaps Russia actually had succeeded in hacking it in a way to keep people from voting in this blue county.
sentences.zh: 这让人产生了很多怀疑，也许俄罗斯真的成功进行了黑客攻击，以至于阻止了人们在这个民主党优势县投票。

sentences.en: And it took three years.
sentences.zh: 这花了他三年时间。

sentences.en: It was only last week, okay?
sentences.zh: 直到上周，好吧？

sentences.en: We're less than a year away from the next election.
sentences.zh: 距离下次大选不到一年了。

sentences.en: It's only last week that investigators at the Department of Homeland Security concluded that actually Russia had not hacked into the system that Durham used, that it looks like
sentences.zh: 直到上周，国土安全部的调查人员才得出结论，实际上俄罗斯并没有黑进达勒姆市使用的系统，看来

sentences.en: technical misconfiguration errors were to blame.
sentences.zh: 技术配置错误才是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: And a lot of people we've talked to have said, maybe that's just the point.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈过的许多人都说，也许这正是关键所在。

sentences.en: Russia doesn't necessarily have to hack the election to throw the outcome into doubt.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯不一定非要黑客攻击选举才能让结果陷入怀疑。

sentences.en: Maybe making Americans question the final outcome of a presidential election is all it needs to do to undermine faith in our democracy.
sentences.zh: 也许让美国人质疑总统大选的最终结果，就是它削弱对我们民主制度信任所需要做的一切。

sentences.en: So you're saying that, yes, Russia is doing the same thing that it did in 2016 now.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，是的，俄罗斯现在正在做它在2016年做过的事情。

sentences.en: It's also doing more, possibly.
sentences.zh: 可能还在做更多的事情。

sentences.en: We don't know what Cozy Bear is up to.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道“舒适熊”在搞什么鬼。

sentences.en: And we suspect that Russia may be pursuing this new attack on the election systems themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们怀疑俄罗斯可能正在对选举系统本身发起这种新的攻击。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So let me paint a picture.
sentences.zh: 所以让我描绘一幅图景。

sentences.en: This would be the worst case scenario that American officials are worried about.
sentences.zh: 这将是美国官员担心的最坏情况。

sentences.en: One, Russia repeats the 2016 playbook, which it looks like they're beginning to do.
sentences.zh: 第一，俄罗斯重复2016年的剧本，他们看起来已经开始这么做了。

sentences.en: They hacked into Burisma.
sentences.zh: 他们黑入了乌克兰天然气公司Burisma。

sentences.en: Let's say they end up dumping emails that are embarrassing to Joe Biden or his son.
sentences.zh: 假设他们最终泄露了让乔·拜登或他儿子尴尬的电子邮件。

sentences.en: And we see a repeat of what we saw with John Podesta and Hillary Clinton in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了2016年约翰·波多斯塔和希拉里·克林顿事件的重演。

sentences.en: And then let's say they add this new prong, okay, which is the possibility that Russia may hack into the election itself.
sentences.zh: 然后假设他们增加了这个新招数，也就是俄罗斯可能黑入选举本身的这种可能性。

sentences.en: We're now in a moment where our faith in institutions is at an all-time low.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于一个对机构的信任度降至历史最低点的时期。

sentences.en: And that is where you get to the true nightmare scenario for 2020.
sentences.zh: 这就是2020年真正噩梦般情景的由来。

sentences.en: Nicole, thank you.
sentences.zh: 妮可，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: You're going to be a juror in the trial in the Senate that's about to start.
sentences.zh: 你将成为即将开始的参议院审判中的陪审员。

sentences.en: Do you worry President Trump will be emboldened by acquittal?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心特朗普总统会因为被宣告无罪而变得更加胆大妄为？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: When I look at what the issue is, it's whether or not we're going to be able to have witnesses.
sentences.zh: 当我审视问题所在时，关键在于我们是否能够传唤证人。

sentences.en: We've asked for only four people as witnesses.
sentences.zh: 我们只要求四个人作为证人。

sentences.en: And if our Republican colleagues won't allow those witnesses, they may as well give the president a crown and a scepter.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的共和党同僚不允许这些证人出席，他们干脆给总统戴上王冠和权杖算了。

sentences.en: They may as well make him king.
sentences.zh: 他们干脆让他当国王算了。

sentences.en: In the seventh Democratic debate, held on the eve of an impeachment trial in the Senate,
sentences.zh: 在参议院弹劾审判前夕举行的第七场民主党辩论中，

sentences.en: the three senators in the race, Amy Klobuchar, Elizabeth Warren, and Bernie Sanders, said they would temporarily return to Washington to act as jurors in the case.
sentences.zh: 参选的的三位参议员艾米·克洛布查尔、伊丽莎白·沃伦和伯尼·桑德斯表示，他们将暂时返回华盛顿，在该案中担任陪审员。

sentences.en: Some things are more important than politics.
sentences.zh: 有些事情比政治更重要。

sentences.en: I took an oath to uphold the Constitution of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我曾发誓维护美利坚合众国宪法。

sentences.en: It says that no one is above the law.
sentences.zh: 上面写着没有人能凌驾于法律之上。

sentences.en: That includes the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这其中也包括美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: We have an impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 我们有一场弹劾审判。

sentences.en: I will be there because it is my responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我会在那里，因为那是我的责任。

sentences.en: Much of the debate focused on foreign policy, with many of the candidates calling for restraint in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 辩论的大部分焦点集中在外交政策上，许多候选人呼吁美国在对待

sentences.en: approach to Iran and expressing a reluctance to enter into a new military conflict in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的方法上保持克制，并表达了不愿卷入中东新军事冲突的抗拒情绪。

sentences.en: But in perhaps the debate's most tense moment...
sentences.zh: 但在辩论中最紧张的时刻...

sentences.en: Senator Sanders, Senator Warren, confirmed in a statement that in 2018, you told her that you did not believe that a woman could win the election.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员，沃伦参议员在声明中证实，你在2018年告诉她，你认为女性无法赢得大选。

sentences.en: Why did you say that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这么说？

sentences.en: Moderators pressed Senator Sanders about the claim made by Senator Warren that Sanders had told her a woman could not be elected president.
sentences.zh: 主持人就沃伦参议员提出的关于桑德斯曾对她说女性无法当选总统的说法，向桑德斯参议员追问。

sentences.en: Well, as a matter of fact, I didn't say it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，我没有说过。

sentences.en: A claim that Sanders has denied.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯对此说法予以否认。

sentences.en: Anybody knows me knows that it's incomprehensible that I would think that a woman could not be president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 任何了解我的人都知道，认为女性不能担任美利坚合众国总统，这对我来说是不可想象的。

sentences.en: Go to YouTube today.
sentences.zh: 今天去YouTube看看。

sentences.en: Warren, however, stood by the claim.
sentences.zh: 然而，沃伦坚持这一说法。

sentences.en: Look, this question about whether or not a woman can be president has been raised, and it's time for us to attack it head on.
sentences.zh: 听着，关于女性能否担任总统的问题已经被提出，是时候让我们正视它了。

sentences.en: And I think the best way to talk about who can win is by looking at people's winning record.
sentences.zh: 我认为讨论谁能获胜的最佳方式是看人们的获胜记录。

sentences.en: Look at the men on this stage.
sentences.zh: 看看这个台上的男士们。

sentences.en: Collectively, they have lost 10 elections.
sentences.zh: 他们总共输掉了10场选举。

sentences.en: The only people on this stage who have won every single election that they've been in are the women.
sentences.zh: 这个台上唯一赢得他们参加过的每一场选举的人是女性。

sentences.en: Amy and me.
sentences.zh: 艾米和我。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天的《每日秀》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Babar.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴尔。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时又令人热血沸腾的权力争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是主持人萨拉·科尼格，我们将为您讲述一些人试图维持其影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
